slot_scores.name: unclear_production_time_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the 110 hours the total available production time per week (i.e., the maximum you can produce), or is it a minimum you must use?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether the 110 hours is a maximum or a minimum/target, clarifying its nature as a soft goal rather than a hard equality constraint.

slot_scores.name: unclear_overtime_limit_goal
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there a separate overtime limit or cost, or should the model simply maximize profit subject to producing at least the minimum sales quantities within 110 hours?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the existence and nature of a separate overtime limit, which led to clarification of the 10-hour overtime rule.
